title: Three data entry points
summary: qteasy reads data through history, reference, and static channels — not a single catch-all API.
narrative:
qteasy exposes three read-only data entries:

- history: time-series bars via get_history_data (OHLCV and related htypes).
- reference: auxiliary series via get_reference_data.
- static: snapshot / classification tables via get_static_data (industry, name, etc.).

Ask names the three doors. Plan `data.read` picks a channel from your wording. Do not invent a fourth mega-API.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
# history / reference / static are separate entries.
print('history', hasattr(qt, 'get_history_data'))
print('reference', hasattr(qt, 'get_reference_data'))
print('static', hasattr(qt, 'get_static_data'))
risk_notes: Mixing channels in one call is not supported. Download/refill is a different Job from read.
